approval_method: User approved each requested transaction in their browser wallet; no private key was accessed.
scope: Planned desktop Chrome/MetaMask flows: submitter-owned community, eligible screening, YES vote, ballot closure, ineligible and clarification screening with blocked voting, and linked revision preserving the original. Does not certify all wallet providers, mobile signing, every edge case, production security or submission readiness.
historical_context: The observations and release_readback below describe the original signing run before the wallet UX/publication follow-up. The wallet connection and balance-preflight issues were subsequently fixed, and both the evidence URL and GitHub repository are now public. Original observations are retained rather than overwritten. See docs/wallet-ux-fixes.md and docs/submission-review.md for the later checks; these are not seven new signatures on the patched frontend.
observations: After initial connection/network switching, the app reported a wallet account or network change and cleared its connected account. Selecting MetaMask again restored the connection on Studio Next without another network change. Initial connection requires further UX review.

Community creation finalized with successful execution and the matching community was read back from finalized contract state. The receipt included a validator entry with vote idle and execution_result ERROR; this record does not claim every validator reported success.

A laptop shutdown interrupted the first unsigned YES vote request. After restart, finalized state showed no vote and the page had no submitted pending hash. Chrome reported MetaMask transport/liveness warnings and reconnection did not persist. Reloading the app and reconnecting restored the same account; a new YES vote request was then approved by the user. No community or proposal was recreated.

Initial close-ballot requests were declined because the signing wallet had insufficient Studio Next (61997) test GEN. The user's 0.05 GEN balance was on stable Studio (61999), not the active chain. The official Studio Next faucet added 10 free test GEN to the same MetaMask address; the verified active-chain balance became 10.00030179030000706 GEN before closing. No real funds were purchased or bridged. The app quotes protocol fees but does not yet precheck the active-chain balance.

The user approved the funded close-ballot request. Its receipt finalized with successful execution and three agreeing successful validator receipts. Two idle/ERROR entries explicitly reported CONSENSUS_VALIDATOR_QUORUM_REACHED (execution cancelled after quorum), not a failed close-ballot execution. Finalized readback and the browser both showed PASSED with YES 1 / NO 0. The recorded vote, proposal body and screening evidence were preserved.
